payload.title: Guideline file form and papyrus guidelines check
payload.description:
One guideline is a folder with GUIDELINE.md: flat front matter (id, type papyrus:Guideline, name, description, kind writing/image/announcement, scope publication/section/<id>/channel/<name>, severity error/warn/guidance, language, avoid, prefer, pattern, maxLength) and prose body. papyrus guidelines check --dir guidelines/ FILE... runs every rule a program can decide with no network and no model, and prints not checked offline plus the rule name for judgement rules. pod check validates the guideline files. A Guideline is never a page. Can run beside slices 1-3.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: A guideline folder is valid or refused (missing kind, unknown key, nested value, bad severity).
- Gherkin: Offline check (a listed word is found with no network; a judgement rule prints not checked offline; exit status reflects error findings only).
- Flat keys only, explicit id, unknown keys refused.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
